review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Mrs Birkett runs the Packhorse Inn and knows every job in the dale: the shifts and the wages, the staff and the customers, applying for a job, the interview, the contract and the day off.
description.sl: Gospa Birkett vodi gostilno Packhorse in pozna vsako delo v dolini: izmene in plače, osebje in stranke, prijavo na delovno mesto, razgovor, pogodbo in prosti dan.
description.it: La signora Birkett gestisce il Packhorse Inn e conosce ogni lavoro della valle: i turni e le paghe, il personale e i clienti, la candidatura, il colloquio, il contratto e il giorno libero.
description.de: Mrs Birkett führt das Packhorse Inn und kennt jede Arbeit im Tal: die Schichten und die Löhne, das Personal und die Gäste, die Bewerbung, das Vorstellungsgespräch, den Vertrag und den freien Tag.

words.example_en: Jack has two jobs: the farm in the day and the inn at night.
words.example_sl: Jack ima dve službi: podnevi kmetijo, zvečer gostilno.
words.example_it: Jack fa due lavori: di giorno la fattoria e di sera la locanda.
words.example_de: Jack hat zwei Jobs: tagsüber den Hof und abends das Gasthaus.
words.note: A job is countable: a job, two jobs. Work is uncountable: I've got a lot of work.
words.note_sl: Job je števen: a job, two jobs. Work je nešteven: I've got a lot of work.
words.note_it: Job è numerabile: a job, two jobs. Work non lo è: I've got a lot of work.
words.note_de: Job ist zählbar: a job, two jobs. Work nicht: I've got a lot of work.

words.example_en: My colleagues at the inn gave me a card for my birthday.
words.example_sl: Sodelavci v gostilni so mi za rojstni dan dali voščilnico.
words.example_it: I miei colleghi della locanda mi hanno regalato un biglietto per il compleanno.
words.example_de: Meine Kollegen im Gasthaus haben mir eine Karte zum Geburtstag geschenkt.

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett is a kind boss, but she likes things done quickly.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett je prijazna šefinja, a ima rada, da je delo hitro opravljeno.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett è un capo gentile, ma vuole che le cose si facciano in fretta.
words.example_de: Mrs Birkett ist eine nette Chefin, aber sie mag es, wenn alles schnell geht.
words.note: Boss is the same for a man and a woman.
words.note_sl: Boss je enak za moškega in žensko: šef in šefinja.
words.note_it: Boss vale per un uomo e per una donna.
words.note_de: Boss gilt für einen Mann und eine Frau: Chef und Chefin.

words.example_en: Sam works the evening shift on Fridays and Saturdays.
words.example_sl: Sam ob petkih in sobotah dela v večerni izmeni.
words.example_it: Sam fa il turno di sera il venerdì e il sabato.
words.example_de: Sam arbeitet freitags und samstags in der Abendschicht.

words.example_en: The wage at the inn is ten pounds an hour, plus tips.
words.example_sl: Plača v gostilni je deset funtov na uro, poleg napitnin.
words.example_it: La paga alla locanda è di dieci sterline l'ora, più le mance.
words.example_de: Der Lohn im Gasthaus ist zehn Pfund die Stunde, plus Trinkgeld.
words.note: A wage is paid by the hour or the week; a salary (B2) by the year or the month.
words.note_sl: Wage se plačuje na uro ali teden; salary (B2) na leto ali mesec.
words.note_it: Il wage si paga a ore o a settimana; il salary (B2) all'anno o al mese.
words.note_de: Wage wird pro Stunde oder Woche bezahlt; salary (B2) pro Jahr oder Monat.

words.example_en: Poppy's mum has applied for a job at the school in Keswick.
words.example_sl: Poppyjina mama se je prijavila za službo na šoli v Keswicku.
words.example_it: La mamma di Poppy si è candidata per un posto alla scuola di Keswick.
words.example_de: Poppys Mama hat sich um eine Stelle an der Schule in Keswick beworben.
words.note: Apply for a job, apply to a company.
words.note_sl: Apply for a job (za službo), apply to a company (v podjetju).
words.note_it: Apply for a job (per un lavoro), apply to a company (presso un'azienda).
words.note_de: Apply for a job (um eine Stelle), apply to a company (bei einer Firma).

words.example_en: I've got an interview at the hotel on Monday, and I'm very nervous.
words.example_sl: V ponedeljek imam razgovor v hotelu in sem zelo živčen.
words.example_it: Lunedì ho un colloquio all'hotel e sono molto nervoso.
words.example_de: Am Montag habe ich ein Vorstellungsgespräch im Hotel und bin sehr nervös.
words.note: An interview is also what a journalist does with someone on the radio.
words.note_sl: Interview je tudi intervju, na primer na radiu.
words.note_it: Interview è anche l'intervista di un giornalista.
words.note_de: Interview ist auch das Interview eines Journalisten.

words.example_en: Have you got any experience of working in a kitchen?
words.example_sl: Imaš kaj izkušenj z delom v kuhinji?
words.example_it: Hai un po' di esperienza di lavoro in cucina?
words.example_de: Hast du schon Erfahrung mit der Arbeit in einer Küche?
words.note: Experience of a job is uncountable: some experience. An experience (countable) is something that happened to you.
words.note_sl: Experience pri delu je neštevno: some experience. An experience (števno) je doživetje.
words.note_it: L'experience di lavoro non si conta: some experience. An experience (numerabile) è un'esperienza vissuta.
words.note_de: Experience im Beruf ist unzählbar: some experience. An experience (zählbar) ist ein Erlebnis.

words.example_en: Mr Dixon's skills with iron are the best in the county.
words.example_sl: Spretnosti gospoda Dixona z železom so najboljše v grofiji.
words.example_it: Le abilità del signor Dixon con il ferro sono le migliori della contea.
words.example_de: Mr Dixons Fähigkeiten mit Eisen sind die besten in der Grafschaft.

words.example_en: Edna worked part-time at the post office for thirty years.
words.example_sl: Edna je trideset let delala za polovični čas na pošti.
words.example_it: Edna ha lavorato part-time all'ufficio postale per trent'anni.
words.example_de: Edna hat dreißig Jahre lang Teilzeit auf der Post gearbeitet.

words.example_en: The school is looking for a full-time teacher from September.
words.example_sl: Šola od septembra išče učitelja za polni delovni čas.
words.example_it: La scuola cerca un insegnante a tempo pieno da settembre.
words.example_de: Die Schule sucht ab September eine Lehrkraft in Vollzeit.

words.example_en: In August we all work overtime, because the inn is full every night.
words.example_sl: Avgusta vsi delamo nadure, ker je gostilna vsak večer polna.
words.example_it: Ad agosto facciamo tutti gli straordinari, perché la locanda è piena ogni sera.
words.example_de: Im August machen wir alle Überstunden, weil das Gasthaus jeden Abend voll ist.
words.note: Overtime is uncountable: do overtime, work overtime.
words.note_sl: Overtime je neštevno: do overtime, work overtime (delati nadure).
words.note_it: Overtime non si conta: do overtime, work overtime (fare straordinari).
words.note_de: Overtime ist unzählbar: do overtime, work overtime (Überstunden machen).

words.example_en: Mr Tyson says he'll retire when his grandson can run the farm.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson pravi, da se bo upokojil, ko bo vnuk lahko vodil kmetijo.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson dice che andrà in pensione quando il nipote saprà mandare avanti la fattoria.
words.example_de: Mr Tyson sagt, er geht in Rente, wenn sein Enkel den Hof führen kann.
words.note: Someone who has retired is retired, a pensioner. Retire has nothing to do with retiring from a room.
words.note_sl: Kdor se je upokojil, je retired, upokojenec.
words.note_it: Chi è andato in pensione è retired, un pensionato.
words.note_de: Wer in Rente ist, ist retired (Austrian: in Pension).

words.example_en: Harry earned five pounds for washing Mr Tyson's car.
words.example_sl: Harry je zaslužil pet funtov, ker je opral avto gospoda Tysona.
words.example_it: Harry ha guadagnato cinque sterline lavando la macchina del signor Tyson.
words.example_de: Harry hat fünf Pfund verdient, weil er Mr Tysons Auto gewaschen hat.
words.note: You earn money by working; you win money in a game or the raffle.
words.note_sl: Earn: zaslužiti z delom; win: dobiti v igri ali na srečelovu.
words.note_it: Earn: guadagnare lavorando; win: vincere a un gioco o alla lotteria.
words.note_de: Earn: durch Arbeit verdienen; win: im Spiel oder bei der Tombola gewinnen.

words.example_en: The staff have their lunch in the kitchen before the inn opens.
words.example_sl: Osebje poje kosilo v kuhinji, preden se gostilna odpre.
words.example_it: Il personale pranza in cucina prima che apra la locanda.
words.example_de: Das Personal isst in der Küche zu Mittag, bevor das Gasthaus öffnet.
words.note: Staff means all the people who work somewhere: the staff are … or the staff is …, both are heard.
words.note_sl: Staff pomeni vse zaposlene: the staff are … ali the staff is …, slišiš oboje.
words.note_it: Staff sono tutti i dipendenti: si sente the staff are … e the staff is ….
words.note_de: Staff sind alle Angestellten: man hört the staff are … und the staff is ….

words.example_en: The first customers come in at noon for soup and a sandwich.
words.example_sl: Prve stranke pridejo opoldne na juho in sendvič.
words.example_it: I primi clienti arrivano a mezzogiorno per una zuppa e un panino.
words.example_de: Die ersten Kunden kommen mittags auf eine Suppe und ein Sandwich.

words.example_en: Mrs Hartley started her career as a teacher in Carlisle.
words.example_sl: Gospa Hartley je kariero učiteljice začela v Carlislu.
words.example_it: La signora Hartley ha iniziato la sua carriera di insegnante a Carlisle.
words.example_de: Mrs Hartley hat ihre Karriere als Lehrerin in Carlisle begonnen.
words.note: Say career like "ca-REER", the stress at the end.

words.example_en: New staff get two weeks of training before they work alone.
words.example_sl: Novo osebje ima dva tedna usposabljanja, preden dela samo.
words.example_it: Il nuovo personale fa due settimane di formazione prima di lavorare da solo.
words.example_de: Neues Personal bekommt zwei Wochen Einschulung, bevor es allein arbeitet.

words.example_en: Read the contract carefully before you sign it.
words.example_sl: Preden pogodbo podpišeš, jo natančno preberi.
words.example_it: Leggi bene il contratto prima di firmarlo.
words.example_de: Lies den Vertrag genau, bevor du ihn unterschreibst.

words.example_en: The National Trust is a big employer in the Lake District.
words.example_sl: National Trust je velik delodajalec v Jezerskem okrožju.
words.example_it: Il National Trust è un grande datore di lavoro nel Lake District.
words.example_de: Der National Trust ist ein großer Arbeitgeber im Lake District.
words.note: The employer gives the work, the employee (stress on -ee) does it.
words.note_sl: Employer daje delo, employee (naglas na -ee) ga opravlja.
words.note_it: L'employer dà il lavoro, l'employee (accento su -ee) lo fa.
words.note_de: Der employer gibt die Arbeit, der employee (Betonung auf -ee) macht sie.

words.example_en: Send your CV to Mrs Birkett by Friday.
words.example_sl: Življenjepis pošlji gospe Birkett do petka.
words.example_it: Manda il curriculum alla signora Birkett entro venerdì.
words.example_de: Schick deinen Lebenslauf bis Freitag an Mrs Birkett.
words.note: CV is curriculum vitae; American English says résumé.
words.note_sl: CV je curriculum vitae; v ameriški angleščini résumé.
words.note_it: CV sta per curriculum vitae; in americano résumé.
words.note_de: CV ist curriculum vitae; amerikanisch résumé.

words.example_en: On my day off I'm going to walk up Catbells.
words.example_sl: Na prosti dan bom šel na Catbells.
words.example_it: Nel mio giorno libero salgo sul Catbells.
words.example_de: An meinem freien Tag gehe ich auf den Catbells.

words.example_en: The inn hires three extra people every summer.
words.example_sl: Gostilna vsako poletje zaposli tri ljudi več.
words.example_it: La locanda assume tre persone in più ogni estate.
words.example_de: Das Gasthaus stellt jeden Sommer drei Leute zusätzlich ein.
words.note: Hire also means to rent for a short time: hire a bike, hire a boat.
words.note_sl: Hire pomeni tudi najeti za kratek čas: hire a bike, hire a boat.
words.note_it: Hire vuol dire anche noleggiare: hire a bike, hire a boat.
words.note_de: Hire heißt auch kurz mieten: hire a bike, hire a boat.

words.example_en: Sam is in charge of the cellar and the beer.
words.example_sl: Sam je odgovoren za klet in pivo.
words.example_it: Sam è responsabile della cantina e della birra.
words.example_de: Sam ist für den Keller und das Bier zuständig.
